tasks.short: Record animal genealogy, feeding, appearance, and breeding

steps.what: Watch the animal for appearance, behavior, feeding, and breeding.
Record information relating to animal genealogy and feeding schedules.

tasks.design: She watches the animal, then files animal record v1 in the animal clinical record on {OTHER}. No model drafts the note. No alert is raised. The filing is her own commit of what she saw.
tasks.previous_blocker: Genealogy, feeding, appearance, and breeding come from looking at the animal. A consult note for a human visit does not record them.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the need for her to see the animal before the record is filed.
tasks.still_hard: Appearance, behavior, and a breeding fact stay with the person who was there.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell what she saw from what she was told.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still watches the animal and files the record herself.

reach.learn: An animal observation is filed by the person who saw it, not handed to a consult note.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she writes the animal record herself after she has seen the animal, and a clinic does not use a human consult scribe for genealogy or feeding.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

She is the producer of what she saw. The fields she files are the identity of the animal, the appearance, the behavior, the feeding or breeding fact, and the date. The animal clinical record is the {OTHER} category. If she did not see a fact she leaves it blank and does not invent it. No model drafts the note. No alert is raised. The record is not a human medical dossier and does not store the owner's health.
Filing animal record v1 is her own commit. She approves that version on the same step. Nothing is sent outside the clinic.
unknowns: Whether a second person must countersign a genealogy entry.
Whether the clinic treats the animal file under a human-dossier retention rule.
research_questions: Who else may correct a feeding schedule after she has filed animal record v1?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one animal she watches, then files the genealogy and feeding schedules, neither step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Educate clients on animal health, nutrition, or behavior

steps.what: Hear clients describe the animal behavior problems.
Decide what to educate or advise on animal health and nutrition.
Advise the clients in person about the animal health problems.

tasks.design: She hears the client, decides the advice, and tells the client in person. No handout is filed and nothing is emailed. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: What to tell this client depends on the animal in front of her and on the problem the client describes.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new speaks the advice for her.
tasks.still_hard: Health, nutrition, and behavior advice stay a conversation with that client.
tasks.human_edge: She can change the advice when the client adds a fact.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still hears the problem, decides the advice, and tells the client.

reach.learn: Live advice to a client is spoken by the person, and no generated note is handed over.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: educating a client on an animal's health, nutrition, or behavior is a live conversation, and a clinic does not send that advice from a model.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Clients are outside the organisation. The advice is live speech. No handout is filed and no advice is emailed, so there is no version to gate. No alert is raised.
She does not read a generated note aloud. The decision uses only what the client just said and what she has seen of the animal.
unknowns: Whether the clinic later requires a written handout after the talk.
Whether the client is the animal's owner or a laboratory sponsor.
research_questions: Does any later task, not this one, send a written nutrition note to the client?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one client visit she hears the problem, decides the nutrition or health advice, and speaks it, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write reports and maintain research information

steps.what: Read her own study notes before the research reports.
Write reports of the research and file research report v1.
Maintain research information or perform clerical duties on the study.

tasks.design: She reads the study notes, writes research report v1 in {DOCS}, and keeps those same notes in order. No model writes the report. Nothing is sent and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The report has to match the study she can stand behind, including gaps she will not fill in.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new writes a research report she can file without reading the notes.
tasks.still_hard: Which observation belongs in the report stays her judgement.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which note she saw and which note she must leave blank.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the notes, writes the report, and keeps the study information.

reach.learn: A research report is filed by the person who accepts the notes, not typed from a consult recording.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she writes the research report from the study notes and a clinic does not file that report from a human consult scribe.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

The study notes already exist. She wrote them during the study, or a scientist who ran the study did. The fields are the study date, the animal or group, and the observation. If a field is missing she does not invent it. If the author is unclear she asks and does not fill the gap. The reading is the first step and is not treated as free. No machine uses the notes.
Research report v1 is the only standing version, and she approves it on the writing step. The clerical step tidies the same notes, files no second version, and sends nothing. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether a second copy of the research report must be filed somewhere else.
Whether the study notes are hers or a scientist's on this study.
research_questions: Who may add an observation to the study notes after research report v1 is filed?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one study she reads the notes, writes the research report, and performs the clerical duties, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

steps.what: Count clinic stores item by item before the books.
File inventory count v1 while maintaining inventories.
Perform bookkeeping for the accounting duties as day book v1.
Draft invoice v1 from the booked services.
Billing customers after checking service and amount on invoice v1.
outputs: invoice v1 given to the customer

tasks.design: She counts the stores, files inventory count v1 and day book v1 in {ERP}, drafts invoice v1 herself, and bills the customer with that version. No model posts the books or sends the invoice. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The count, the service, and the amount have to be ones she will stand behind before a customer is billed.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new counts the stores or decides the amount for her.
tasks.still_hard: A missed item and a wrong amount stay hers to catch.
tasks.human_edge: She can leave blank an item she did not count and a service she did not book.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still counts the stores, posts the books, drafts the invoice, and bills the customer.

reach.learn: A customer invoice goes out only as the version she checked, and it names the service and the amount.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she posts the clinic books and bills the customer herself, and the invoice names the service and the amount rather than a diagnosis.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

She counted the items in the first step. The fields she files on inventory count v1 are the item and the quantity she just counted. If she did not count an item she leaves it blank. No machine reads the count.
Day book v1 names the service and the amount for services she knows were given. She posts it herself. The invoice is not part of that posting.

She drafts invoice v1 herself from day book v1. That draft step is her own writing. It is not gated, and it does not wait for a later check of itself. No model writes it. Billing customers is a separate step: she checks the service and the amount on invoice v1 and gives that version to the customer. The invoice does not state a diagnosis. No model sends it. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether the invoice must show a diagnosis.
Whether every inventory item is hers to post.
research_questions: Who else may change the amount on invoice v1 after she has billed the customer?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one day she counts the stores, files the inventories, posts the bookkeeping, drafts the invoice, and bills the customers, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

role.altitude: She still watches the animal and files the record, advises the client, writes the research report, counts the stores, posts the books, and bills the customer. Nothing is handed off.
reach: A medical assistant learns she does not hand an animal observation to a consult note.
A pharmacy aide learns a customer invoice is sent only as the version she checked.
skills_to_grow: Write the animal record from what she saw.
Bill from the service she booked, not from a diagnosis line.
role.ambitious_version: The same assistant still records, advises, writes, and bills. No note, advice, report, or invoice is sent in her place.
